invariants.rationale: The returned Stream instance should not be null as it is created via Stream operations.
The partition parameter is passed to super and is expected to be valid.
All FileSlice elements in the result satisfy the clustering small file size condition enforced by the filter.
The Stream anyMatch with a true predicate returns true if at least one element exists, matching findAny().isPresent().
No FileSlice in the result can have a basefile size greater than or equal to the configured limit.
